bibl.title: Five Ptolemaic Demotic "Marriage" Contracts (P.Tebt. Frag. 15161, 15162, 402, 411+412, P.Tebt. 3.982 descr.)
bibl.seg: Jacqueline E. Jay, Five Ptolemaic Demotic "Marriage" Contracts (P.Tebt. Frag. 15161, 15162, 402, 411+412, P.Tebt. 3.982 descr.).
bibl.note: Presents text editions of five fragmentary Demotic marriage contracts in the collection of the Center for the Tebtunis Papyri at the University of California, Berkeley. They are all of the sẖ n s‘nḫ type and were likely produced at Hawara. Two concern relationships between Greek soldiers and Egyptian women. - 1. P. Berkeley Tebt. Frag. Inv. 15161. 158/157 BCE. - 2. Inv. 15162. 158/157 BCE. - 3. Inv. 402. 149-140 BCE. - 4. Inv. 411 + 412. Mid-3rd century BCE? - 5. P. Tebt. III, 982 descr. 2nd century BCE.
